content: Resilience4j SemaphoreBulkhead runs on caller thread (fits virtual threads); ThreadPoolBulkhead hands off to platform pool and loses MDC context - avoid with virtual threads. Annotation default aspect order: Retry(CircuitBreaker(RateLimiter(TimeLimiter(Bulkhead(fn))))). Configure CB ignoreExceptions for business/permanent and BulkheadFullException if CB wraps bulkhead. RabbitMQ 4.0 quorum queues default delivery-limit 20 (dead-letter with reason delivery_limit).
